name: Shoalcade
description: Shoalcade for Jellyfin: play your own games on your Android phone (offline) and in the browser, with every save kept safe on your Jellyfin server.
overview: Your own game library in Jellyfin: phone app, browser player, safe saves

versions.changelog: s0.13: Xbox 360 in the Windows app: your own discs, saves shared through Jellyfin. Phone app 0.16.0 and Windows app 0.16.0.

s0.12: Continue card at the top of your games, controller shortcuts (hold Select + R1, L1, R2, L2), a controller rumble switch, Smooth picture on the phone, permanent Discord link. Phone and Windows apps 0.15.0.

s0.11.1: GameCube, Wii and PS2 snapshots from the Windows app are kept on Jellyfin. Windows app: GameCube and Wii games no longer go black or flicker, PS2 games close cleanly, an Automatic snapshot switch, console-coloured icons. Phone app 0.14.1: delete a snapshot.

Shoalcade v0.11.0: GameCube, Wii and PS2 in the Windows app; games on more than one disc are one game (old disc saves move across by themselves); the Windows app looks like the plugin; GBA cheats typed without a space work; safer browser player; accessibility fixes

Shoalcade v0.10.0: the first Windows app, internet link play, Celio Link (opt-in), fast-forward, screenshots, play time, search and filters, automatic save upload; the plugin now accepts saves from the Windows app

s0.9 - Nintendo 3DS in the phone app (app 0.12.0), favourites, download all your saves, delete all saves of a removed game (kept hidden 7 days), update banner in the app. Release notes: https://github.com/BBBannon/Shoalcade/releases/tag/v0.9.0

s0.7 - RPG Maker removed; loading bar, Nintendo/Sony console bar, Mute and download message fixes (browser + phone app 0.10.0). Release notes: https://github.com/BBBannon/Shoalcade/releases/tag/v0.7.0
s0.5 - Nintendo 64 games (browser + phone app 0.8.0). Release notes: https://github.com/BBBannon/Shoalcade/releases/tag/v0.5.0
s0.4 - ROM patcher page and cheats (browser + phone app 0.7.0). Release notes: https://github.com/BBBannon/Shoalcade/releases/tag/v0.4.0
s0.3 - first public release. Release notes: https://github.com/BBBannon/Shoalcade/releases/tag/v0.3.0
